profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that describes itself as a commercial-stage global developer of autonomous driving technology spanning Level 2 to Level 4. Its site points to the WeRide One universal autonomous driving platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, accumulated real-world operational data, and autonomous driving solutions across the L2 to L4 range. The company says its business footprint covers more than 60 cities across 13 countries and that it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi.

WeRide is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800. The company states that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2026 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists. Its SEC filing record carries CIK 0001867729.

No lawsuits involving the company are recorded, and no MCP servers or individual products are separately tracked in the material reviewed.
